name: Futsuu Datta Ore ga Choukyou Sarete Do M ni Natta Wake
original_name: 普通だった俺が調教されてドMになったワケ
source:
A visual novel on the concept of "the pleasure of being mistreated". Every heroine torments, tantalizes, crushes and dominates the protagonist. Enjoy his journey step by step into misery, and then, bliss.

Makoto Suzuhara was the most vanilla high schooler. He was fine with his average friends, average life.

There was one girl in his class though. Her name is Sena Sado, and she decided Makoto belongs to her. Meanwhile, Kuroe Shiba also secretly liked Makoto, and wise to Sena's plan she intended to break him first... different girl, same relentless method.

Two girls is more than enough to break any guy, then you add the half-serious stylings of Ohka Himeji...

Who would finally plant her flag of ownership in Makoto's poor abused body? Regardless, he's never going to be the same.

Enjoy the story of a normal guy who gets trained into a super masochist.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE149862.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部以“被虐待的乐趣”为主题的视觉小说。每个女主角都在折磨、诱惑、碾压、支配主角。享受他一步步走向痛苦，然后走向幸福的旅程。

铃原诚是最普通的高中生。他和他的普通朋友相处得很好，过着普通的生活。

不过他班上有一个女孩。她的名字叫佐渡濑名，她认定诚是属于她的。与此同时，黑江芝也暗恋着诚，并且明智地理解了濑名的计划，她打算先摧毁他……不同的女孩，同样的残酷手段。

两个女孩足以让任何男人崩溃，然后再加上Ohka Himeji的半严肃造型……

谁最终会将她的所有权旗帜插在诚那可怜的、受虐待的身体上？无论如何，他永远不会和以前一样了。

享受一个普通人被训练成超级受虐狂的故事。
